breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Include Boussinesq approximation coefficients in the thermophysical properties,' which directly repeats the original flawed instruction. The ground truth removes all references to Boussinesq approximation (both from the descriptive text and from the mixture dictionary) since it conflicts with the compressible perfectGas model. The agent failed to identify and resolve this inconsistency.
